0x00082D.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00089E.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000926.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009A0.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000B50.en: 「Gah! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B8B.en: 「No way I flame out here...!@　This isn't funny...」

0x000BDF.en: 「Slipped up...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000CC9.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D30.en: 「This is the end... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000D62.en: 「Damn it...!@ This is as far as I go!」

0x000D9E.en: 「Nngh! Looks like they got the drop on me...」

0x000DDC.en: 「No good, we took too much... I'm retreating!」

0x000E29.en: 「Well, I'm beat. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E67.en: 「Kyaah, the rest is up to you!」

0x000F59.en: 「Gah... So I burn out as a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x001010.en: 「Owowow... I give up, my math was off.」

0x001051.en: 「Aw shoot, they went and got me!」

0x001095.en: 「U... ngh! So this is the end...!」

0x001149.en: 「Sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00117E.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x00126A.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012B8.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Pulling back!」

0x0013A2.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013E0.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x00140F.en: 「I can't go on. I'll take my leave.」

0x00149A.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll fall back for now...!」

0x001600.en: 「I'm ejecting...@ Ngh...! Not a graceful exit...」

0x00182D.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x0018D0.en: 「No good, they got me after all.」

0x001902.en: 「I've got no choice but to retreat...!」

0x001999.en: 「...Zamzeed's emergency repairs are done.@ The staff here are a really talented bunch.」

0x001A1C.en: 「Masaki piloted Cybuster on the surface,@ and the Steel Dragon Squadron flies all kinds of@ machines, so everyone's got plenty of experience.」

0x001AD9.en: 「They serviced my machine as well.@ I'm most grateful.」

0x001B32.en: 「Indeed. The work is every bit as good@ as the Langran Army's own mechanics.」

0x001BA0.en: 「...Hey, can I ask something? Why were@ the <Machinery Gods> and <Machine Beasts>@ built in the first place?」

0x001C65.en: 「...Now that you mention it, I never really did.」

0x001CA8.en: 「Then I'll tell you. What set the@ Machine Beasts' development in motion was@ a prophecy from the Langran Royal Academy's seers.」

0x001D5C.en: 「It went: 'A colossal demon god shall destroy@ Langran, and it shall rain calamity down@ upon all living things in La Gias.'」

0x001E38.en: 「Yes. So to gain the power to oppose it,@ they decided to develop the <Machine Beasts> and <Machinery Gods>.」

0x001EBF.en: 「Until then, no weapon that powerful@ existed here in La Gias.」

0x001F30.en: 「Huh... so they built the Machine Beasts off@ something as shaky as a prophecy.」

0x001FA4.en: 「Shaky...?@ Oh, right, on the surface prophecies almost never come true.」

0x00202B.en: 「Places without Langran's completed@ Laplace Transform Theory rely on@ individual intuition a lot, right?」

0x00211D.en: 「Highly reliable.@ But a prophecy is only a possibility,@ so it can still be changed by human hands.」

0x0021A4.en: 「Which is exactly why Langran decided to@ develop the <Machine Beasts> and <Machinery Gods>.」

0x002210.en: 「But why are the pilots of the machines that@ save Langran surface-dwellers? People from@ this world could just pilot them.」

0x0022C8.en: 「Moving a Machine Beast takes <Plana>... 'ki.'@ And it has to come from intense swings of emotion.」

0x002359.en: 「Intense swings of emotion, huh.@ That fits Masaki, all right...」

0x0023DA.en: 「Mio, deep down you must have great surges@ of emotion too. Am I wrong?」

0x002467.en: 「Are people like that... people with enough@ Plana to pilot a Machinery God... rare@ in Langran, then?」

0x002524.en: 「Yes... that's why surface-dwellers like@ Masaki and me were summoned as candidate@ pilots for the <Machinery Gods> and <Machine Beasts>.」

0x0025EB.en: 「Granveil is piloted by a surface-dweller@ named Huang Yang Long.」

0x002653.en: 「And I'm the one Zamzeed chose,@ aren't I...」

0x0026A6.en: 「Mio, let me make sure one more time, just in case...@ You're certain about this?」

0x002734.en: 「Yes. If Zamzeed chose her,@ it's not my place to say anything.」

0x0027AB.en: 「I feel the same.@ Mio, please take good care of Zamzeed.」

0x00283B.en: 「...Master Masaki, what will you do about Diablo?」

0x00289A.en: 「Hey, big brother...@ can I pilot Diablo?」

0x00291B.en: 「You can't stop me, big brother.@ I can fight too. I want to help.」

0x00298C.en: 「Besides, Grandpa Madock let me ride@ in Diablo a few times.」

0x002A31.en: 「Things are hard right now, aren't they?@ If we don't take back the capital soon, Langran...」

0x002A9F.en: 「But still...@ Tytti, say something to her too.」

0x002AF8.en: 「It's fine, Presia. Go ahead and pilot Diablo.」

0x002B4B.en: 「That's Big Sis Tytti for you! You get it!」

0x002BB6.en: 「Masaki, Presia is Zeorute's daughter.@ It's fine. Believe in her.」

0x002C31.en: 「...I understand how you feel.@ But sooner or later...」

0x002CB8.en: 「...All right.@ Just don't push yourself too hard, Presia.」

0x002D4B.en: 「Then we'd better tune Diablo up.@ Come on, Presia.」

0x002DF4.en: 「Presia's real father...@ He was the swordsmanship and martial arts@ instructor at the Langran court. And my master, too.」

0x002E99.en: 「Yes, the 'Sword Emperor,' a master of the@ Jingi Mukyu-ryu style... A wonderful man, beloved by all.」

0x002F19.en: 「Come to think of it, you were...@ old man Zeorute's junior, weren't you?@ Back in the officers' academy.」

0x00302B.en: 「This was before I met you all on the surface, though.」

0x00306B.en: (That's part of why Masaki went after@ Doctor Shirakawa...)

0x0030C8.en: 「Looks like we've found the Shutedonias bunch!@ Let's move out!」

0x003131.en: 「The outcome here is all but decided.@ Take these guys down and a promotion's not just a dream.」

0x0031A9.en: 「We're outnumbered...@ But if we don't stop the enemy here,@ Lord Feil's plan will...!」

0x0032C8.en: 「Tch, they've gotten this far!@ Jesuha's rout is coming back to bite us!」

0x003321.en: 「That's the surface-dwellers' battleship Hagane...@ and Zamzeed as well.」

0x003374.en: 「You're General Ort, right?@ We'll handle the rest.@ You pull back for now.」

0x00341A.en: 「I'll take the thought, but no.@ We've got three Machinery Gods here.」

0x003479.en: 「So go lend Lord Feil a hand, General.@ You'd rather that too, right?」

0x003524.en: 「...Presia, Mio,@ you two aren't used to your machines yet.@ Stay back and focus on support.」

0x0035D9.en: 「Roger that here too!@ Let's go, Zamzeed!」

0x003617.en: 「The Machinery God Zamzeed...@ If only we could field that machine ourselves...!」

0x0036C2.en: 「All units! Even against Machinery Gods,@ strike first and we'll find our opening!」

0x00372A.en: 「Drive these guys back here and we won't just@ turn the tide, we'll crush the Will of@ Langran's whole army! Fight hard!」

0x0037EE.en: 「We're this close to taking back the capital!@ We won't let you do as you please any longer!」

0x003874.en: 「...Where are our reinforcements?@ What are those surface-dweller mercenaries doing?」

0x00392D.en: 「So all three siblings have shown their faces now.」

0x003970.en: 「Chiot Argent, was it? Are you the only reinforcement?」

0x0039B9.en: 「That's right.@ I didn't really want to come, but@ Chienne told me to, so here I am.」

0x003A53.en: 「Your army seems to be in real trouble.@ Chien said he'd wrap things up whenever, and@ I'm planning to do the same.」

0x003B11.en: 「I'd rather get this job done and go home to the surface.@ Unlike Chienne and the others,@ I don't want to stick around here long.」

0x003BB0.en: 「That one's got a different air from the other two...?」

0x003BED.en: 「You've got no bite to you...@　twisted in a whole other way.」

0x003C4C.en: 「I don't care who I'm up against.@　It's a pain, so just hurry up and lose.」

0x003CBA.en: 「Then you shouldn't have stuck@　your nose in a place like this!」

0x003D19.en: 「Word is, if we help the Shutedonias army,@　we get to go back to the surface.」

0x003D9D.en: 「But Chienne and the others plan to keep@　making money down here too, so@　I'm just going along with them.」

0x003E27.en: 「Down here...? You're mercenaries@　on the surface too?」

0x003E70.en: 「Not exactly, but I've got no reason@　to tell you the truth. Besides,@　I'd rather not get tangled up with you.」

0x003F00.en: 「Then let's have the boy make a quick exit.@　We're kind of busy here, y'know?」

0x003F7A.en: （Ugh, what a hassle... let's wrap this up quick.）

0x003FBA.en: 「Tch, I can't hold them off!@　Much as it pains me, we retreat!」

0x004020.en: 「All enemy signals in the combat zone,@　gone. No enemy in detection range.」

0x004083.en: 「Captain, message from the Feil army.@ The Shutedonias forces in the royal capital@ have begun withdrawing.」

0x0040FE.en: 「Then the operation's a success, for now...」

0x004194.en: 「Big brother... we can go home to the capital now?」

0x0041DA.en: 「Yeah. Let's hope this buys us a breather...」

0x004220.en: 「No point sticking with Zares any longer.@　I'm heading home.」

0x004282.en: 「My, my, they pulled out awfully fast.」

0x0042B9.en: 「Let them go!@　We'll drive out the ones who stayed!」

0x004306.en: 「Father, watch over me! I'll do my best!」

0x004349.en: 「Why did you attack us on the surface?」

0x004377.en: 「I was just ordered to, that's all.」

0x00443B.en: 「I've got no obligation to tell you that.」

0x004475.en: 「Cybuster!@　Take you down, and Langran's Will drops!」

0x0044D4.en: 「Shut it!@ You think a <Masou Ki> can beat a <Masou Kishin>!?」

0x00452B.en: 「You lot, get out of the royal capital, now!」

0x004571.en: 「You're the ones who should leave! Langran@　is meant to be ruled by our Shutedonias!@　For the good of all La Gias!」

0x00461C.en: 「The Masou Kishin Zamzeed! I'll take it@ back with my own two hands!」

0x004672.en: 「Zamzeed chose me!@　I'm not handing it over to you!」

0x0046E0.en: 「What!? A little girl like you,@　the new pilot!?」

0x00475E.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Langran Province, Royal Capital

0x0047B1.en: 「...We've retaken the royal capital@　from the Shutedonias army. Once more,@　my thanks for all your efforts.」

0x00484D.en: 「No... the hard part starts now, doesn't it?」

0x00488A.en: 「Yes. The Shutedonias army may have pulled out@　of the capital, but not every battle is over.@　They're massing forces around Redona Canyon.」

0x004962.en: 「So they don't intend to back down quietly.」

0x0049A8.en: 「Tytti and I are one thing, but@　what should the Steel Dragon Squadron do?」

0x004A07.en: 「We must first confer on rebuilding the@　capital and our future military operations.」

0x004A81.en: 「Investigating the summoning, searching for@　surface-dwellers and their return home@　come after that.」

0x004B1A.en: 「Lt. Col. Tetsuya, my apologies, but...@　until preparations are complete, I'd ask@　you all to remain in the royal capital.」

0x004BEA.en: 「If you need supplies, just say the word.@　We'll do everything we can.」

0x004C61.en: 「Please don't trouble yourselves.@　Prioritize rebuilding the capital.」

0x004CC9.en: 「Then, I've a war council at the palace.@　Excuse me.」

0x004D19.en: 「...The war's far from over, it seems.」

0x004D59.en: 「Yeah... we may have to lean on@　everyone again.」

0x004DB2.en: 「I know we've no choice till we get home, but...@　getting too deep into La Gias's affairs@　is something we must avoid.」

0x004E91.en: 「In any case, we can catch our breath here.@　Masaki, if you want to head into the capital, go ahead.」

0x004F11.en: 「Guess so... haven't been home in a while...@　Maybe I'll take you up on that.」

0x004FA4.en: 「...So anyway, I'm heading home.@　Anyone want to come along?」

0x005006.en: 「I was thinking of cooking dinner...@　It's more fun with a crowd.」

0x005111.en: 「I appreciate the thought, but@　we haven't got clearance to leave ship.」

0x005176.en: 「Besides, the pilots need to@　stay on standby aboard.」

0x0051F1.en: 「If the captain cleared Masaki to disembark,@　shouldn't you two be fine to go?@　You're civilian aides, not Steel Dragon crew.」

0x0052CA.en: 「Sure, I'll hold down the fort.@　And I'll square it with@　Captain Viletta for you.」

0x005351.en: 「I'll call if anything comes up, so@　have fun for us too.」

0x0053F9.en: 「You and Tsugumi are the chaperones.@　Besides, I want you to go see@　what the royal capital's like.」

0x0054B7.en: 「Well, just look at Tytti, Princess Xenia,@ and little Presia - they're proof enough.」

0x005537.en: 「Well, setting aside Lt. Irmgard's talk...@　out in town, we might pick up info@　on the summoned surface-dwellers.」

0x00560E.en: 「Then I'll go along with Ibis and the others.」

0x0056B7.en: 「Um... if it's all right,@　I'll cook something at home and bring it over.」

0x00572F.en: 「Yeah. I'm good at Japanese food.@　I've picked up a lot from big brother.」

0x005806.en: 「...Now, let Chief of Staff Novus@　brief us on the current situation.」

0x00586C.en: 「At present, the Shutedonias army holds@　the southeast of the continent... and further east,@　the Kirkus army has set up camp.」

0x005917.en: 「On this map: green is our forces,@　blue is the Kirkus army, and@　red is Shutedonias.」

0x0059B0.en: 「Our forces and Kirkus have@　Shutedonias pincered between us,@　but the reverse holds true as well...」

0x005A55.en: 「Our forces are caught between Shutedonias@　and Bagonia, and Kirkus between@　Shutedonias and its homeland.」

0x005AFA.en: 「For now our forces keep winning,@　and we seem to hold the advantage, but...@　we can't ignore the enemy's potential.」

0x005BA5.en: 「In sheer numbers, Shutedonias still@　outmatches us... a head-on decisive battle@　would be reckless.」

0x005C47.en: 「...So we've no choice but to join@　hands with Kirkus, for now...」

0x005CA0.en: 「In my humble view, that is the best course.」

0x005CDA.en: 「...What is it? We're in council here.」

0x005D49.en: 「Your Highness, a message from General Kirkus.」

0x005E0B.en: 「It's been a while, Prince Feil.@　I figured it was about time you'd consider@　an alliance with my army, so I called.」

0x005EED.en: 「...Good timing, General Kirkus.@　By rights we'd meet in a formal parley,@　but we haven't that luxury.」

0x005F9B.en: 「The top priority now is driving the@　Shutedonias army from this country as soon@　as possible. You'll not dispute that.」

0x006074.en: 「Now, how to put this... True, I once@　ate the salt of the Langran Kingdom myself.@　My wish to save this land is the same as yours.」

0x006137.en: 「And yet, when Langran faced its true crisis,@　where, pray, was Your Highness@　to be found?」

0x0061D0.en: 「When Langran's heart was struck down,@　who shed blood fighting to protect this land...?」

0x006244.en: 「If I may be so bold, was it not myself@　and my comrades?」

0x00628D.en: 「Kirkus! You go too far before His Highness!」

0x00630B.en: 「I've no ties to the old Langran now.@　What good is dressing up appearances at this@　late hour? Am I wrong?」

0x0063AD.en: 「...So you're saying you've no will@　to form an alliance?」

0x006403.en: 「No, no.@　I merely grieve for Langran's fate@　after we've driven Shutedonias back.」

0x00649F.en: 「Are you telling me to recognize your@　independence, Kirkus?」

0x0064F2.en: 「Heavens, I'd never dream of such presumption...@　I only wish to see Langran restored to peace.」

0x00658D.en: 「And yet, if the one to wear the crown@　of the new Langran is Your Highness...@　I have some misgivings.」

0x006676.en: 「The one fit to be king of the new Langran...@　That is Prince Terius.」

0x006760.en: 「Terius!? What is the meaning of this!?」

0x0067A6.en: 「Just as Kirkus explained. I'm to be@　the first king of the new Langran Kingdom.」

0x006820.en: 「Absurd!@　Prince Terius is third in line for the throne!@　To pass over Prince Feil and Princess Monica!」

0x0068BC.en: 「As I said before, Prince Feil is a bit@ of a worry as the new king...」

0x00692A.en: 「One never knows when he might vanish...@　Oops, have I said too much?」

0x006998.en: 「And Princess Monica's whereabouts remain@　unknown... so it stands to reason we@　raise up Prince Terius.」

0x006A3D.en: 「Insolence! Would you defile our storied@　royal house, Kirkus!?」

0x006AC4.en: 「Kirkus...@　If I recognize Terius's accession,@　you'll form the alliance?」

0x006B92.en: 「But only after every Shutedonias soldier@　overrunning this country has been driven out.@　Understood, Kirkus?」

0x006C28.en: 「As shrewd as ever, Prince Feil.@　In that case, we'll spare no cooperation.」

0x006CA2.en: 「And the moment matters are settled,@　we'll hold Prince Terius's coronation.」

0x006D61.en: 「What are you thinking?@　Kirkus means to use Prince Terius as a puppet@　and seize control of the nation.」

0x006DEE.en: 「I know, Novus.@　But driving out the Shutedonias army@　is the first priority.」

0x006E5C.en: 「Besides, a king is a mere ornament.@　What matters is securing enough power in@　the council to check Kirkus's schemes.」

0x006F2F.en: 「These are turbulent times.@　Langran must change...」

0x006F8B.en: 「...Then let me ask one last thing.」

0x006FC8.en: 「If Kirkus resorts to extreme measures,@　are you prepared to take up arms against him?@　Even at the cost of being branded a traitor?」

0x007082.en: 「Of course.@　My wish is peace for all of La Gias.@　I'll never permit Kirkus's tyranny.」

0x007112.en: 「That eases my mind.@　Leave the operational talks with Kirkus's army@　to me. I'll not let them have their way.」

0x007244.en: 「You said royal capital, so I pictured@　some futuristic city, but...@　what a stylish little town.」

0x0072C8.en: 「How to put it... it's just a@　wonderfully pleasant view.」

0x007321.en: 「True, there's no rows of skyscrapers@　like the big cities up on the surface...」

0x007398.en: 「Perfect for a date spot.@ Right, Yuu?」

0x0073E2.en: 「...Don't cling so close.@　We didn't come here to play.」

0x007466.en: 「...So anyway, are we there yet, Masaki?」

0x00753C.en: 「Even I don't get lost going to my own house.」

0x007585.en: 「...Huh, so this is Masaki and Presia's place.@　Nice spot.」

0x0075E4.en: 「Been away a while, so I gotta clean up...」

0x00764C.en: 「No, no. Everyone just relax.@　Presia, get some tea going for now.」

0x0076FA.en: 「So you brought your own. Figures, you tea nut.」

0x007777.en: 「You bet... @　Try serving him some slapdash tea from a bag @　and his charged particle cannon'll open fire.」

0x007820.en: 「...Masaki, would you kindly stop @　spouting nonsense?」

0x0078B3.en: 「Naturally. Today it's Nuwara Eliya, and @　Lover's Leap at that. I watched the water @　temperature closely to keep the bitterness down.」

0x007973.en: 「Even if you say that, I've got no idea...」

0x0079B0.en: 「He's always like this. Just tune it out.」

0x0079F3.en: 「Well then, I'll have some. @　Um, sugar goes...」

0x007AB0.en: 「Ty-Tytti... ma'am...@　you put in that much sugar, the tea'll...」

0x007B1E.en: 「Hm? I thought I went easy on it...」

0x007BDB.en: 「Yeah, she's got a sweet tooth. @　...A monstrous, off-the-charts one.」
